entries: {SOMEONE:!threatening} met {first} at {landmark} {MANNER}, refusing to name what lived there.
{first} {ACT_PERSON} {SOMEONE:human}, but the {rival} had already reached {CLOSE:human} in the night.
Each time {first} came near {PRIZE:!inner}, the dark took something back.
{first} followed the scratching to {landmark} and waited {MANNER} with {THING:portable}.
{the_someone} would not speak of {TOPIC}, and the lights in {place} kept failing.
